# EXT-01 · Process depth and delivery checks

Learner packet A · No outcome reveal · Read with the [coaching protocol](../../../workflow/coaching.md).

## Context available for the first attempt

A public PM skill library currently has a narrow product-retirement communication tool. A dated plan proposes expanding coverage across readiness, internal preparation, stakeholder coordination, and communications. The same library serves small feature deprecations and larger product retirements.

The plan proposes three process depths. A skill can receive the depth selected upstream, or classify it when invoked on its own. The author wants coherent guidance across the suite. You are reviewing the design before accepting that interaction contract.

No observation of real users completing the proposed workflow is supplied. This packet summarizes a public plan; it does not establish customer demand or adoption. You are not being asked to execute a retirement, install a skill, or inspect private client materials.

## First question

**这套流程首先应该帮助使用者解决什么问题？请先说明你认为最重要的使用情境。**

Assistant: wait for the learner's answer. Do not disclose the author's later design changes or steer toward a particular dependency model. Preserve the answer, then ask one question about its most important gap.

A later packet introduces delivery evidence. Its outcome remains withheld. The case's information cutoff is reconstructed from dated plan/handovers inspected at a later pinned revision, not a recovered verbatim design meeting.
